tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background in every screen. Text on it uses foreground or muted-foreground.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Default text on background, and the text color of the page.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Surface of cards and raised panels. Text on it uses card-foreground.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Surface of popovers, menus, selects and the command palette. Text on it uses popover-foreground.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one main action on a screen: the filled button, and selected states of checkbox and switch. Text on it uses primary-foreground.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Fill of secondary buttons and badges. Text on it uses secondary-foreground.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fill for skeletons, table stripes, tabs and disabled areas. Text on it uses muted-foreground.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Helper text, captions and placeholders on background and muted. In the light theme it is about 4.3 to 1 on muted, below the 4.5 to 1 floor; the stock gray values are kept as they are.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and focus fill of menu items, ghost buttons and list rows. Text on it uses accent-foreground.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and error text on background. Pair it with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers and card edges. Not for control edges; those use input. In the dark theme it is about 2.9 to 1 on background, below 3 to 1; the stock values are kept.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Edge of text fields, selects and checkboxes. In the light theme it is about 1.3 to 1 on background, below 3 to 1; the shadow-xs of the field carries the edge. The stock values are kept.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring around any focused control, drawn at half strength. In the light theme it is about 2.6 to 1 on background, below 3 to 1; the stock values are kept.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First series of a chart. Use with a legend or labels, never color alone.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second series of a chart.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third series of a chart.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth series of a chart.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth series of a chart.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Surface of the app sidebar. Text on it uses sidebar-foreground.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the selected item mark in the sidebar. Text on it uses sidebar-primary-foreground.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sidebar-primary.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Hover and active fill of sidebar items. Text on it uses sidebar-accent-foreground.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sidebar-accent.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Dividers inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring of controls inside the sidebar.

families.sans: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"
families.heading: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

styles.name: text-sm
styles.usage: Table text, control labels and dense forms. The size most parts use.

styles.name: text-3xl
styles.usage: The largest heading, for a landing or empty screen.

tokens.name: spacing
tokens.usage: The base unit: every gap, padding and margin is a multiple of it (4 pixels). A section gap is 6 units; a card and field gap is 4 units.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Corner size of cards, buttons, fields and popovers. The parts derive their smaller and larger corners from it.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, selects, checkboxes and switches.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Popovers, selects and dropdown menus when open.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets and the largest open menus.
